/hr/k8s-gateway.kryptonian.kapsi.fi-k8s-.doc:
k8s_gateway is a CoreDNS plugin that resolves all types of external Kubernetes resources.

It will gather all domains from all services, ingresses, and HTTPRoutes resources and create a DNS record for each of them, corresponding to the service IPs. This ensures that all external resources are resolved from within the cluster, and traffic is not leaving the cluster.

Most people deploy the k8s_gateway together with CoreDNS and call the Helm Release 'k8s-gateway'. This can be supplimenting along side the kube-dns or default CoreDNS from k3s.

0:
# Create automation files if they don't exist
for file in automations.yaml scripts.yaml scenes.yaml; do
  if [ ! -f "/config/$file" ]; then
    echo "Creating /config/$file"
    if [ "$file" = "scripts.yaml" ]; then
      echo "{}" > "/config/$file"
    else
      echo "[]" > "/config/$file"
    fi
  else
    echo "/config/$file already exists"
  fi
done

set -e
mkdir -p /config/custom_components

# custom_components must only contain component dirs - clean up
# stray files left by the old flat extraction
find /config/custom_components -maxdepth 1 -type f -delete

while IFS='|' read -r name url || [ -n "$name" ]; do
  if [ -z "$name" ]; then
    continue
  fi
  case "$name" in \#*) continue ;; esac

  # Trim whitespace (block scalar indent / stray spaces)
  name=$(printf '%s' "$name" | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//; s/[[:space:]]*$//')
  url=$(printf '%s' "$url" | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//; s/[[:space:]]*$//')
  [ -z "$name" ] && continue

  echo "Installing $name..."
  wget -qO /tmp/component.zip "$url"
  rm -rf /tmp/extract
  mkdir -p /tmp/extract
  unzip -q /tmp/component.zip -d /tmp/extract

  # Locate the component dir: flat zips keep files at the archive
  # root (manifest.json), source archives nest it under
  # custom_components/<name> (possibly in a wrapper folder)
  if [ -f /tmp/extract/manifest.json ]; then
    src=/tmp/extract
  else
    src=$(find /tmp/extract -type d -path "*/custom_components/$name" | head -1)
    if [ -z "$src" ]; then
      echo "ERROR: could not locate component '$name' in archive"
      exit 1
    fi
  fi

  # Overwrite so a version bump in the manifest applies on next start
  rm -rf "/config/custom_components/$name"
  mkdir -p "/config/custom_components/$name"
  cp -r "$src"/. "/config/custom_components/$name/"
  rm -rf /tmp/extract /tmp/component.zip
  echo "$name installed"
done < /custom-components/components.txt
